comics.title: Virasen: Dawn of the Blade
comics.description: In an ancient realm besieged by shadowy cosmic demons, Virasen, an exile warrior armed with the mythical Saptarshi Blade, must unite fractured celestial kingdoms before the eternal eclipse consumes Aryavarta.

chapters.title: The Celestial Awakening
chapters.synopsis: The stars shatter over the Vindhyas, calling an outcast champion back to arms.

episodes.title: Ashen Skies of Aryavarta
episodes.synopsis: Dark meteors strike the border outposts. Virasen witnesses the descent of the shadow horde.

episodes.title: The Saptarshi Blade Unsealed
episodes.synopsis: Trapped in the temple crypt, Virasen breaks the ancestor blood oath to defend innocent villagers.

episodes.title: Demon Vanguard of the Abyss
episodes.synopsis: A terrifying general of the Mahishur Nether realm steps onto the battlefield.

chapters.title: The Fortress of Agni
chapters.synopsis: Marching into the volcano citadels where the ancient weaponsmiths still forge divine iron.

episodes.title: River of Molten Embers
episodes.synopsis: Navigating the subterranean lava passages beneath Mount Meru.

episodes.title: The Lion Shield of Chola
episodes.synopsis: The legendary golden armor is unveiled before the vanguard.

comics.title: Neo Madras 2099
comics.description: Set in a neon-drenched, monsoon-soaked futuristic metropolis, Detective Dev investigates cybernetic syndicate murders tied to an illegal memory-harvesting neural chip called Maya-4.

chapters.title: Rain & Ruin
chapters.synopsis: Detective Dev takes a case in the shadows of the High-Tech Bay Expressway.

episodes.title: Neon Alleys of Central
episodes.synopsis: A corpse found with glowing blue spinal cord ports.

episodes.title: The Synthetic Memory Market
episodes.synopsis: Infiltrating the black market neural bazaar beneath Marina Tower.

comics.title: Curse of Mahishur
comics.description: Deep within forgotten granite gopurams, an ancient emerald spirit fire has awakened. Warrior maiden Tara must master the sacred twin spears to seal an encroaching demonic realm before the dark eclipse.

chapters.title: The Whispering Gopuram
chapters.synopsis: Tara enters the prohibited temple grounds.

episodes.title: Spears of the Guardian
episodes.synopsis: The guardians of stone break their thousand-year slumber.

episodes.title: Green Flame Resurgence
episodes.synopsis: The spectral emerald fire engulfs the inner sanctum.

comics.title: Monsoon Whispers
comics.description: A gentle, heartwarming slice-of-life webtoon about two art students in Ooty who share a bright yellow umbrella on a stormy afternoon, unfolding an inspiring journey of creative dreams and tender love.

chapters.title: Under the Yellow Umbrella
chapters.synopsis: A sudden downpour by the tea plantations brings two strangers together.

episodes.title: First Droplets of June
episodes.synopsis: The scent of wet earth and an open sketchbook.

episodes.title: Sketches by the Lake
episodes.synopsis: Tracing misty pine hills while waiting for the heritage train.

comments.content: The armor design on Virasen is sensational! The Indian mythological armor paired with manga speed lines feels so fresh and intense.

replies.content: Thank you Balaji! We spent weeks researching traditional Chola and Vijayanagara battle attire to blend with Shonen aesthetics.

comments.content: Tamil signboards in a cyberpunk metropolis! This is what comic fiction in India needed for so long.

copyrightDocs.title: Platform Content Ownership & Author Intellectual Property Policy
copyrightDocs.summary: Explicit framework guaranteeing authors retain 100% intellectual property rights to their comic titles, artwork, character lore, and scripts.
copyrightDocs.fullText:
1. AUTHOR INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY SOVEREIGNTY:
All original comic books, webtoons, manuscripts, graphic illustrations, and character names uploaded to Aathirai_Comic remain the exclusive intellectual property of the respective registered author. Aathirai_Comic acts strictly as a non-exclusive digital distributor and publishing facilitator.

2. GRANT OF LIMITED DIGITAL DISTRIBUTION LICENSE:
By submitting and publishing a comic on Aathirai_Comic, the author grants the platform a revocable, non-exclusive digital hosting license solely to render pages for registered readers, facilitate secure INR Razorpay transactions, and promote the work on homepage showcases.

3. DIGITAL RIGHTS MANAGEMENT & WATERMARKING:
All comic pages served through the Aathirai_Comic reader utilize encrypted image streaming to prohibit unauthorized digital extraction and scraping.

4. INFRINGEMENT REPORTING & TAKEDOWN (DMCA & INDIAN COPYRIGHT ACT 1957 COMPLIANCE):
Any copyright holder noticing unauthorized re-upload of protected artwork can file an instant infringement notice via copyright@aathirai.com. Notices will be reviewed within 24 business hours by the Administrator.

settings.termsCustomer:
1. ACCOUNT & ACCESS: Users must maintain accurate account credentials. Do not share your reading access.
2. COMIC CONSUMPTION: Purchasing an episode, chapter, or comic grants a personal, non-transferable digital reading license.
3. INDIAN PAYMENTS & RAZORPAY: All purchases are billed in Indian Rupees (INR ₹) with applicable taxes. Supported methods include UPI, Indian debit/credit cards, and Net Banking.
4. REFUND POLICY: Due to the immediate delivery of digital comic pages, purchases are non-refundable once unlocked, unless technical server errors occur.
5. COMMUNITY CONDUCT: Comments containing hate speech, offensive language, or piracy links will result in account termination.
settings.termsAuthor:
1. AUTHOR APPLICATION & VERIFICATION: Author status requires formal administrator approval before publishing privileges are granted.
2. ORIGINAL CONTENT GUARANTEE: Authors represent and warrant that all submitted comics are 100% original creations free of copyright infringement.
3. REVENUE SHARING: Authors receive 70% of gross INR sales from their premium episodes and comics, minus standard gateway processing fees.
4. PAYOUT THRESHOLD: Minimum payout threshold is ₹500 via direct UPI or NEFT bank transfer upon request.
5. CONTENT MODERATION: Aathirai_Comic reserves the right to unpublish comics containing prohibited or abusive material.
